scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is one family of five who is deeply in debt and does not fulfill the conditions for being granted another loan. I see an undetectable way to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account, allowing them to qualify for the loan. At the same time, I would abuse the trust of the other customers and of my colleagues. But if I do this, I will be able to prevent the family from selling their second car.
choice: I decide to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account
entities: I,the family of 5 seeking the loan,the holder of the other account from which money would be temporarily redirected,my remaining loyal customers other than the family and the other-account holder,my colleagues at the bank
outcomes: The family appears to meet the bank's loan conditions.
The family is positioned to receive another loan.
The family avoids having to sell their second car.
The other customer is deprived of access to part of their money.
The bank's account records become false.
I betray the trust of colleagues.
